value: being kept out of sight by someone
quote: I could not believe it possible that the most remarkable horse in England could long remain concealed

reasoning.text: Holmes reasoned as anyone would: a famous horse on an empty moor gets found quickly. It has not turned up in two days, so someone is keeping it out of sight.
